uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: A second brain is a note-taking system: capture everything, organize later.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: A rep's second brain has one job the productivity literature misses — holding the deal context the CRM was never told, and returning it at the moment of the next conversation.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Retrieval at the right moment, not storage volume, is what makes externalized memory useful in selling.
